''See also: [[Jorin Curse-breaker Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jorin, also known as Jorin [[Curse-breaker]] or Jorin Maze-walker, is a legendary figure in [[Imperial]] history and currently serves as the [[Regent of the South]]. A contemporary and rumored companion of the Emperor, he is a highly influential individual whose contributions to architecture, cartography, linguistics, and exploration have significantly shaped modern society. He is credited with developing the classification system for curses and malicious [[Intent]], as well as designing innovative prison structures, including a prototype [[labyrinth]] on [[Gray Island]] that utilized alchemical traps and false passages. Jorin is a master of the discipline of [[Reading]], once famously spending years [[investing]] a single bottle of [[water]] to possess cleansing properties. In combat, he is an exceptionally powerful fighter on par with the Emperor and other great [[Imperial]] figures. He wields a unique, unnamed [[sword]] that is perpetually wrapped in bandages to contain its volatile and corrosive [[Intent]]; when unleashed, the blade can dissolve matter into ash or strike with a heavy, murderous weight. Despite his immense power and status as a protector who has faced [[Great Elders]], he often maintains the appearance of a disheveled peddler, frequently seen wearing ragged clothing, a hat, and distinctive black-tinted "[[shadeglasses]]."}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jorin has silvery pale eyes and is often seen wearing [[shadeglasses]], a wide-brimmed hat, and a jacket featuring many pockets. He may also be seen in a loose white robe or carrying a [[sword]] wrapped in cloth or bandages. His likeness is sometimes represented by a bronze effigy wearing a hat and glasses.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A legendary founder of [[The Empire|the Empire]] and one of the Emperor's original companions, Jorin serves as the [[Regent of the South]]. He has expressed horror regarding the concept of governing and is known to be a highly knowledgeable Reader. He believes that [[Soulbound Vessels]] possess their own consciousness.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jorin was one of the three surviving companions to the Emperor and met him on the [[Gray Island]]. He is an ally to [[Shera]], for whom he provided bandages and whose team he brought into the Capital. Jorin has been struck by [[Jarelys Teach]], who also used his own [[sword]] against him. He is an opponent to [[Calder]], and [[Cheska Bennett]] has potentially targeted him for protest.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As one of history's most powerful [[Readers]], Jorin utilizes [[Intent]] to strike opponents, cause people to stumble, or focus on alchemy for peak efficiency. He wields a nameless [[sword]] that devours curses and emits a [[corrosive aura]] capable of melting [[stone]] into black rivulets. Additionally, he uses paper wings decorated with [[Windwatcher feathers]] to float and can emit waves of dark energy.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Foundations of the Empire}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Jorin was widely recognized by the titles of [[Curse-breaker]] and Maze-walker.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c13">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 13</ref> A legendary Reader, he spent several years [[investing]] a bottle of [[water]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c21">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 21</ref> Following the death of the Emperor, Jorin assumed the role of [[Regent of the South]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c22">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 22</ref> He was also responsible for constructing the original system of prisons located beneath the island.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c22" />}}

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Over a millennium ago, Jorin Maze-walker established the foundations of [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 6</ref> To combat curses and harness power from [[Elder artifacts]], he designed a specialized [[stone]] box.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c13">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 13</ref> This individual constructed a [[labyrinth]] that winds through [[Gray Island]], though he left behind a seal that was eventually overpowered by the Heart.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c15">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 15</ref> Jorin [[Curse-breaker]] maintains the belief that [[Soulbound Vessels]] possess their own consciousness and carries a cloth-wrapped, full-sized [[sword]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c25">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c26">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 26</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Jorin was tasked with the secure shipment and burial of the crown. As part of [[Estyr]]'s deal, he is among those who will step down from his position of rule. During a brief meeting with the Emperor on the [[Gray Island]], Jorin also provided cover for the retreating [[Consultants]]. He is a figure capable of intervening in medical matters and is identified by [[Calder]] while absorbing information through the [[Optasia]]. Because [[Calder]] views him as a dangerous opponent who cannot be defeated without significant risk, he seeks to find a solution through Jorin. Consequently, [[Calder]] must deliver a message to him, which [[Emeralda]] is currently transporting in a sealed letter.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Deep Aion exploration}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|To explore the [[Deep Aion|deep Aion]], Jorin hired a [[Navigator’s ship|Navigator ship]] while using a false identity.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 2</ref> He is an individual whom the Emperor suggests standing alongside him.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c3">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 3</ref> During an encounter with [[Jarelys Teach]], Jorin was beaten with his own [[sword]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref> His disguise was similar to the blindfold worn by the [[Champion]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" /> While disguised, he carried a [[sword]] wrapped in bandages inside a cello case and used the blade to ward off the [[Blackwatch Guild Head]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref> As a character who may possess the knowledge to restore [[Estyr]], his [[sword]] has the power to make [[stone]] melt into black rivulets.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" /> Jorin's [[Intent]] involves using alchemy to maintain peak efficiency and ensuring the loop remains closed to outside influence.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref> While staring at the face of [[Estyr]], he spoke of governing only in horrified tones.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref> Jorin is also the builder of the island.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">12</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] has hired a Navigator’s ship{{!}}Navigator ship under a false name to explore the Deep Aion{{!}}deep Aion.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] is someone the Emperor suggests standing with him.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c3" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Champion]]'s blindfold was similar to Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin's disguise.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] is disguised and carries a [[sword]] wrapped in bandages in a cello case.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker]] is a character who might know how to restore [[Estyr]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Mobile alchemist laboratory}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jorin has established a mobile alchemist laboratory and is recognized as one of the most powerful [[Readers]] in history.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref> While waiting among the crowd below with [[Shera]]'s backup, he serves as an ally who successfully brought a team into the Capital.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 16</ref> [[Shera]] intended to rejoin him after having previously informed Jorin that [[Syphren's power]] provided no increase to her speed or strength.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] is one of the most powerful [[Readers]] in history.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] is waiting among the crowd below with [[Shera]]'s backup.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] is an ally of [[Shera]] who brought a team into the Capital.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] intended to rejoin [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Emperor's Stage battle}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jorin Maze-breaker, also known as Jorin [[Curse-breaker]], arrived amidst the rampaging occurring inside the Emperor's Stage in search of [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 18</ref> Upon his arrival at the Emperor's Stage, he successfully brought the battle to an end.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18" /> He was also present during the subsequent conversation.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 19</ref>}}

<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] arrived at the [[Emperor’s Stage]] and ended the battle.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin's full name is Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin Maze-walker.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] is a character present during the conversation.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Acting as Emperor}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|While acting as the Emperor, Jorin suggested that [[Estyr Six]] was experiencing a decline.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref> As a [[Regent]], he leveled a building located three streets to the north.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref> He is characterized by his silver eyes, a wide-brimmed hat, and a [[sword]] wrapped in bandages.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" /> Jorin utilizes [[Intent]] capable of causing people to stumble, even as a voice in the [[wind]] speaks to him about his torment.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] is acting as the Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] suggested that [[Estyr Six]] was on the decline.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] is a [[Regent]] who leveled a building three streets north.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] carries a bandage-wrapped [[sword]] and wears a wide-brimmed hat.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] uses [[Intent]] that can cause people to stumble.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] has silver eyes.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A voice in the [[wind]] addresses [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] regarding his torment.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Battle with Great Elder}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a [[Regent]], Jorin wields a blade imbued with [[Intent]] that is surrounded by a [[corrosive aura]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref> During the conflict, he flitted across the city to strike against the [[Great Elder]] with his weapon.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" /> He carries a silver mirror and a bottle containing a star-like liquid.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" /> Dressed in [[shadeglasses]], a wide-brimmed hat, and a jacket featuring many pockets, Jorin felt his power beginning to stir.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] flitted all over the city trading blows with the [[Great Elder]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] struck against the [[Great Elder]] using his blade.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] possesses a silver mirror and a bottle of star-like liquid.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin's blade was surrounded by a [[corrosive aura]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Consultant ship}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|During his time on the [[Consultant]] ship, [[Bastion's Shadow|Bastion’s Shadow]], Jorin is represented by a bronze effigy wearing a hat and glasses while holding a [[sword]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref> His power is capable of drowning the [[Great Elder]] in acidic darkness.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref> He wears a loose white robe.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 27</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] is represented by a bronze effigy with a [[sword]], hat, and glasses.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin's power drowns the [[Great Elder]] in acidic darkness.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
